suites.name: RFC 8610 biguint
suites.cddl: biguint = #6.2(bstr)

ruby.explanation: RFC 8610 §3.6 / Appendix D biguint explicitly uses tag 2. Ruby cddl.rb synthesizes a tag-2 bstr when validating any nonnegative decoded Integer, so it also accepts untagged integer 0. The RFC-derived tag expectation is retained.

  rater-value,

  rating-value,
  ? conf-value,
  ? normal-value,
  ? sample-value,
  ? gen-value,

}
